claims.statement: Tom Allen left St. Louis on December 1, 1875 to give sparring exhibitions in Louisville, Cincinnati, Columbus, Cleveland, Pittsburg, Buffalo and other cities.
claims.excerpt: exhibiting hiz science in the manly art at Louisville, Cincinnati,

claims.statement: Young Donnelly was to travel with Tom Allen as his sparring partner on the tour.
claims.excerpt: .ourg Tionnelly, who will enjoy the honor of! facing Tom in his mimic battles

notes: The partner's name is garbled in the OCR ('ourg Tionnelly'); 'Young Donnelly' is taken from the hint and the usual name.
